title: fix(app-shell): the delegated-admin scope facet shows the spec default for an unset key
body:
Fixes #26706

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio › Access › 权限集 › 委派管理(Delegated admin)里的开关,对范围里没有设置的键显示协议(`AdminScopeSchema`)的默认值;管理员切换开关时才写入显式的布尔值。
- 为什么改:委派管理是大客户安全下放管理权的方式,屏幕上显示的委派范围必须和服务端实际执行的一致,管理员才能正确判断自己授出了什么。
- 风险与回滚:只改前端显示,不改存储数据、保存载荷和服务端校验;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` 的 `ADMIN_SCOPE_SWITCH_DEFAULTS` 与 `scopeSwitchOn`(风险 hunk:两个 Switch 的 `checked`);新测试 `PermissionAdvancedFacets.adminScopeDefault-26706.test.tsx`;`PermissionAdvancedFacets.adminScopeAnchor.test.tsx` 里两处期望值的更新。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionAdvancedFacets.adminScopeDefault-26706.test.tsx`(先 build `@objectstack/spec`),预期 `Tests 6 passed (6)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The delegated-admin scope facet shows the spec default for an unset key.

- Each switch in the Delegated admin facet now draws `scopeSwitchOn(scope, key)`: the scope's own boolean when it sets one, and otherwise the spec default for that key from `ADMIN_SCOPE_SWITCH_DEFAULTS`. That is the value `AdminScopeSchema` parses the key to and the value the server enforces.
- Drawing a default writes nothing. The draft keeps an untouched key unset, so a save keeps it unset. A flip writes an explicit boolean, as before. The write paths (`setScope` / `setScopeDetail`) and the business-unit gate are unchanged.
- The two defaults are restated, not imported, for the reason `useTenancyPosture` gives (the `@objectstack/spec/security` value entry adds its schema modules to the console bundle). They are typed against the spec's `AdminScope`, and the new test reads every expected value from the installed spec, so a default the spec moves fails CI here.
- Landing site: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx`, the site the card expected. A grep of `ui/` for the two keys finds no other surface that draws them.

## Tests

- New `PermissionAdvancedFacets.adminScopeDefault-26706.test.tsx`, 6 cases: a CONTROL that the installed spec parses each unset switch key to a boolean default; an unset key draws the spec default (with a business unit, and while the switches wait for one); naming the business unit writes that key alone; a flip writes an explicit boolean and draws it, and flipping back keeps the key written; an explicit boolean draws as itself.
- `PermissionAdvancedFacets.adminScopeAnchor.test.tsx`: two expectations updated. Each asserted the boolean a single flip writes from the drawn state, and that value follows what the switch draws.
- Ablation, one time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: one switch's `checked` reading was put back to its pre-change expression (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `cabc1416e0fd` to `c5282ce2ba31`). Result: `Tests 6 failed | 12 passed (18)` across the two facet files, in the direction declared in advance (red). Restored: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the component by relative path, so the run read `src/` and no `dist/` leg applies. Run on `3592965f`; the merge of `main` since then does not touch the facet or its tests.

## Acceptance notes

- None. No out-of-scope finding.
